about: A 4 x 4 m canal water tile: the clear water surface at -0.9 m over the canal bed at -2.0 m. Two side by side make the 8 m canal. Origin at the near wall's line.

acoustics.about: materials carry glTF extras {"acoustic": <preset|"none">}; large near-level meshes carry node extras {"acoustic": <preset>} (what the game reads); relief, trim, clutter and plants are left out

notes: the water surface is a single translucent quad (glTF alpha blend); ripples, reflection and flow are runtime shader work, not baked
